title: ADOPTION OF PORT MASTER PLAN AMENDMENT NO. 30 TO ADD THE MARITIME SUPPORT USE TO ONE LOCATION IN PLANNING AREA 2
text:
RESOLUTION NO. ____________ - ADOPTION OF PORT MASTER PLAN AMENDMENT NO. 30 TO ADD THE MARITIME SUPPORT USE TO ONE LOCATION IN PLANNING AREA 2
Transmittal 1
Transmittal 2
Transmittal 3
Summary
: Staff requests that the Los Angeles Board of Harbor Commissioners (Board) adopt proposed Port Master Plan (PMP) Amendment No. 30 (Amendment) and authorize the Executive Director to submit the Amendment to the California Coastal Commission (Coastal Commission) for certification. This Amendment was previously adopted by the Board on June 11, 2026, after a public hearing on February 12, 2026. On June 23, 2026, Councilmember McOsker of the 15th District moved that the Los Angeles City Council, pursuant to City Charter Section 245, assert its jurisdiction over this matter and remand it back to the Board to allow more time for the developer to meet with Wilmington community members and address their concerns. The Councilmember has indicated that the developers have subsequently made good faith efforts to work with the community as requested. This Board action would support the Strategic Plan Objective for strong relationships with stakeholders, as it would support the development of a neighboring truck and chassis parking lot facility on land that was sold by the Harbor Department for this purpose; in addition, the facility will reduce illegal on-street truck parking in the Wilmington community. The Amendment would modify the PMP Planning Area 2 – West Basin/Wilmington land use map by changing the land use designation for 16.2 acres of the hillside property north of John S. Gibson Boulevard (“JSG hillside”) from Open Space to Maritime Support. This property was found to be surplus property and was sold by the City of Los Angeles Harbor Department (Harbor Department) with a covenant of sale permitting development consistent with maritime support uses. AIGGRE San Pedro Industrial Owner LLC (AIGGRE) proposes developing Port-adjacent hilltop property and the JSG hillside for the John S. Gibson Truck and Chassis Parking Lot Project (Project). The Project would be built on the flat land at the top of the hillside and a roadway would be built connecting the hilltop with John S. Gibson Boulevard. Before a Coastal Development Permit can be issued, the PMP must be amended to designate the JSG hillside for Maritime Support uses.
Recommendation
: Board resolve to 1) find that the Director of Environmental Management has determined that the proposed action has been previously evaluated pursuant to the requirements of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Article II Section 2(i) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines; 2) adopt Port Master Plan Amendment No. 30; 3) authorize the Executive Director to submit Port Master Plan Amendment No. 30 to the California Coastal Commission for Certification; and 4) adopt Resolution No._______________.
summary: Adoption of Port Master Plan Amendment No. 30 to redesignate 16.2 acres of John S. Gibson hillside from Open Space to Maritime Support for truck and chassis parking lot project in Wilmington.
